data.content:
Here's a summary of the analysis and changes made:

## Build Performance Baseline

| Metric | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Clean build | ~1.9–2.7s | ~1.5–1.8s |
| Incremental build | ~1.2–2.6s | ~1.2–1.5s |

## Optimizations Applied

### 1. Defer analyzers/docs to Release/CI only (`Directory.Build.props`)
- **`GenerateDocumentationFile`** — XML doc generation on every build adds I/O overhead; now Release/CI-only
- **`EnforceCodeStyleInBuild` + `AnalysisLevel=latest-recommended`** — runs expensive Roslyn analyzers on every keystroke-build; now gated on `Configuration == Release` or `ContinuousIntegrationBuild == true`
- **`TreatWarningsAsErrors`** — kept for CI enforcement, removed from dev inner loop

### 2. Remove redundant transitive `ProjectReference`s
- **BusinessLogic** referenced both `DataAccess` and `Common` — Common is already transitive via DataAccess
- **WebApi** referenced all 3 lower projects — only needs `BusinessLogic`
- **Tests** referenced all 4 projects — only needs `WebApi`

This reduces MSBuild graph evaluation and avoids redundant dependency resolution.

### 3. Remove duplicate `TargetFramework` from `.csproj` files
Already centralized in `Directory.Build.props` — the per-project declarations were redundant.

### 4. Trim unused solution platforms
Removed `x64` and `x86` platform configurations (all mapped to `Any CPU` anyway), cutting the solution configuration matrix from 6 to 2 entries.
